name: Himeka Uchida
source:
The main viewpoint character of Blooming Nightshade and Flowering Nightshade.

Himeka is a second-year high school student. She's cheerful and friendly, but sensitive about her height.

She has become good friends with Izumi and Kiyomi in the year and a half since starting high school. Even so, she has started to daydream about romance lately.

[From [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/blooming-nightshade]Itch.io[/url]]
